Use one record per paper, presentation or other output. Start with the work people have actually completed, then record expectations and the authorship decision separately.

Apply the authorship standard governing the output. Use this record to document the discussion alongside institutional, publisher, contractual, ethical, community and legal requirements.

## Prepare the final author-contribution declaration

Use the declaration fields in the copyable template to describe completed work for the exact output being submitted. Follow the venue's required form and keep each proposed author's review, approval and accountability confirmation with the record. CRediT roles describe the work; the governing authorship criteria still determine eligibility.

## Completed example

*Illustrative example; replace these details with your own verified record.*

**Output:** Withdrawal-prediction methods paper.
**Standard:** institution's current Australian-Code-aligned authorship procedure plus selected journal policy.

| Person | Completed | Expected | Responsibility | Provisional status | Trigger |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Candidate A | concept, protocol, data audit, initial code | analysis, first draft, revisions | whole output; data and analysis sections | first author | analysis role materially changes |
| Statistician B | design consultation | verify model, draft technical methods | model and methods | provisional co-author | expected work not completed |
| Supervisor C | methodology development, governance support | substantive critical revision | framing and interpretation | provisional co-author | contribution or accountability changes |
| Data steward D | authorised extract and metadata explanation | factual data-flow check | no manuscript accountability | acknowledgement with permission | intellectual contribution expands |

**Review trigger:** after the validated analysis and before full-draft circulation. The record states that provisional order is not permanent entitlement.

## Check your record

Circulate the provisional record through an appropriate route and retain corrections, agreement or unresolved disagreement. A filled table does not establish consent to the author list.

## Scenario test

A senior collaborator requests authorship after providing access but has not made a scholarly contribution and will not review the manuscript. Do not add or refuse them solely by status. Apply the current standard, explain the accountable contribution required, offer an appropriate acknowledgement if permitted, document the conversation, and seek independent advice if power or retaliation makes direct resolution unsafe.
